name: day-status-tracker
description: Full-stack day status tracker: authenticated yearly data input grid and a public calendar viewer.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
